annotations.title: Ask to change how the App Store version is released

description: Asks a person to approve changing the app's App Store release option: AFTER_APPROVAL (Apple releases a version as soon as App Review approves it) or MANUAL (it waits, Pending Developer Release, until a person releases it with ploa_appstore_release). Ploa keeps it for the app and puts it on each next version before it goes to App Review; the newest version gets it too while Apple still takes a change (until it approves that version), otherwise that one stays as it is. A scheduled date is set with ploa_details_save (review.releaseType SCHEDULED). Nothing changes at Apple until a person approves on the Ploa dashboard (unless ploa_access says this agent is autonomous); check it with ploa_approval_status. ploa_app_review_status says the option now.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
